description: Source code for NavCategory and NavCategoryGroup classes managing calculator categories, including support for different view modes, categories initialization, and user policies.

classes.name: NavCategory
classes.description: Represents a calculator or converter category with view mode, icon, and support properties.

classes.name: NavCategoryGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of categories, including initialization and resource management.

classes.name: NavCategoryStates
classes.description: Manages current user, category groups, and view mode serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: IsCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is a calculator mode (Standard, Scientific, Programmer).

methods.name: IsGraphingCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is Graphing.

methods.name: IsDateCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is Date.

methods.name: IsConverterViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is a converter mode.

methods.name: IsModeInCategoryGroup
methods.description: Checks if a view mode belongs to a specific category group.

methods.name: NavCategoryGroup
methods.description: Constructor initializing category group with resource strings and categories.

methods.name: SetCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current user ID for policy-based features.

methods.name: CreateMenuOptions
methods.description: Creates menu options for calculator and converter categories.

methods.name: CreateCalculatorCategoryGroup
methods.description: Creates calculator category group.

methods.name: CreateConverterCategoryGroup
methods.description: Creates converter category group.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a view mode to an integer for storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes stored data to a view mode, considering graphing policy.

methods.name: GetViewModeForFriendlyName
methods.description: Gets view mode from a friendly name string.

methods.name: GetFriendlyName
methods.description: Gets friendly name string for a view mode.

methods.name: GetNameResourceKey
methods.description: Gets resource key for a view mode.

methods.name: GetGroupType
methods.description: Gets category group type for a view mode.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Gets 0-based index of a view mode.

methods.name: GetFlatIndex
methods.description: Gets flat index considering category groups.

methods.name: GetIndexInGroup
methods.description: Gets index within a specific category group.

methods.name: GetPosition
methods.description: Gets 1-based position of a view mode.

methods.name: GetViewModeForVirtualKey
methods.description: Gets view mode associated with a virtual key.

methods.name: GetCategoryAcceleratorKeys
methods.description: Retrieves accelerator keys for categories.

methods.name: IsValidViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is valid.

methods.name: IsViewModeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is enabled, considering graphing policy.
